items.question: Question 1 put to the subject?
items.subject_said: A price is a claim about what the buyer is comparing you against.

items.question: Question 2 put to the subject?
items.subject_said: Discounting to close a deal teaches the buyer to wait next time.

items.question: Question 3 put to the subject?
items.subject_said: The cheapest hire is the one who needs the least supervision.

items.question: Question 4 put to the subject?
items.subject_said: A deadline nobody set is a deadline nobody owns.

items.question: Question 5 put to the subject?
items.subject_said: Most meetings are a vote held without anyone saying so.

items.question: Question 6 put to the subject?
items.subject_said: A roadmap is a prediction, and predictions are priced.

items.question: Question 7 put to the subject?
items.subject_said: The first version should be the one you can throw away.

items.question: Question 8 put to the subject?
items.subject_said: A contract is the record of what you both feared.

items.question: Question 9 put to the subject?
items.subject_said: Paying for speed buys you a different set of problems.

items.question: Question 10 put to the subject?
items.subject_said: A reference check is worth more than a second interview.

items.question: Question 11 put to the subject?
items.subject_said: Working software is the only honest status report.

items.question: Question 12 put to the subject?
items.subject_said: Churn is a lagging indicator of a conversation nobody had.

items.question: Question 13 put to the subject?
items.subject_said: A budget is the only document that cannot be negotiated upward.

items.question: Question 14 put to the subject?
items.subject_said: Hiring ahead of revenue is a bet on a number you do not have.
